name: skillnote
description: Self-hosted skill registry for AI coding agents. Auto-sync versioned SKILL.md collections into Codex, with a session picker, the native /skills menu, and usage analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted skill registry that syncs SKILL.md collections into Codex.
interface.longDescription: SkillNote is a self-hosted registry for reusable agent skills. Connect Codex to your SkillNote server and the skills in your active collection sync into Codex automatically — pick a collection at session start, browse them with /skills, and create or update skills without leaving Codex. Skills sync mid-session too, so collection changes show up without a restart.
defaultPrompt: Show my active SkillNote collection and the skills it synced.
Change my SkillNote collection for this project.
Create a new SkillNote skill from the pattern we just used.
